answer: Graded-work ladder: every identity begins at its nadir, zero voting weight. Registration earns nothing; one rung needs five-of-seven validator sign-off on an audited task, one-rung per-30-day cap, and a 500-credit bond slashed on failure. 1,000 fakes front 500,000 credits plus per-try fees before one vote counts; a cold-start tundra phase withholds rewards until three tasks verify. The shale check samples funding/timing, so a coordinated ring's shared sources break independence and quorum weight never accumulates.
